assets.prompt: One Piece Dressrosa, a complete miniature island diorama for an ocean world map. A round rocky island with a dense colorful Spanish Mediterranean town, red tiled roofs, sunlit cream stone walls, flower gardens, a circular stone colosseum, and a tall central flat-topped rocky plateau crowned by a royal palace. Distinct layered terraces, green trees, varied little buildings. Clear low sandy entrance at front center, facing positive Z, for a separate wooden dock. Whole island isolated, no ocean plane, no pedestal, no people, no ships, no text. Carefully sculpted stylized game miniature with hand-painted warm colors.

One Piece Punk Hazard, a complete miniature circular island diorama for an ocean map. Split dramatically in half by a deep central ravine: one side black volcanic rock, glowing orange lava rivers and a red volcano; the other side snowy white mountains, blue ice spires and frozen trees. Small ruined science laboratory near center. A continuous low rocky shoreline connects the two halves, with a clear flat shore entrance at front center facing positive Z for a separate dock. Whole object isolated, no ocean plane, no pedestal, no people, no ships, no text. Richly colored hand-painted stylized game miniature.

One Piece Hachinosu Pirate Island, complete miniature rocky island diorama for an ocean map. Huge unmistakable gray skull-shaped central mountain with hollow black eye sockets and a gaping mouth cave. A ramshackle pirate town of colorful red and brown rooftops, crooked towers, stone stairs, green palms and small rocky terraces clustered around the skull. Irregular low shoreline with a clear front-center beach entrance facing positive Z for a separate wooden dock. Entire island isolated, no ocean plane, no pedestal, no people, no ships, no text. Intricate sculpted hand-painted stylized game miniature, dark stone and warm pirate-town colors.

One Piece Long Ring Long Land, a complete miniature ring-shaped grassy archipelago diorama for an ocean map. Six low rolling bright-green grassy islets joined by thin pale sandy land bridges around a central empty lagoon, a few comically tall slender trees with small rounded canopies and one tiny nomad hut. Soft rounded hills and clean low sandy shores. Clear connected front-center shore facing positive Z for a separate wooden dock. Whole archipelago as one compact coherent object, no water surface in lagoon, no ocean plane, no pedestal, no people, no ships, no text. Charming hand-painted stylized game miniature with emerald grass and warm cream sand.
